<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant File Processing Service
 * Handles file operations with tenant isolation via chroot-like path enforcement
 */

class TenantContext {
    private string $tenantId;
    private string $baseDir;
    private int $permissionLevel;

    public function __construct(string $tenantId, int $permissionLevel = 0) {
        $this->tenantId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId);
        $this->baseDir = '/var/tenants/' . $this->tenantId . '/data';
        $this->permissionLevel = $permissionLevel;
    }

    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getBaseDir(): string { return $this->baseDir; }
    public function getPermissionLevel(): int { return $this->permissionLevel; }
}

class PathResolver {
    /**
     * Resolves a relative path within tenant boundary.
     * Uses realpath after construction to prevent traversal.
     */
    public static function resolve(TenantContext $ctx, string $relativePath): ?string {
        // Normalize separators
        $relativePath = str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath);
        
        // Strip leading slashes to force relative interpretation
        $relativePath = ltrim($relativePath, '/');
        
        // Construct candidate path
        $candidate = $ctx->getBaseDir() . '/' . $relativePath;
        
        // Resolve symlinks and relative components
        $resolved = realpath($candidate);
        
        // If file doesn't exist yet (for writes), resolve parent
        if ($resolved === false) {
            $parentDir = realpath(dirname($candidate));
            if ($parentDir === false) {
                return null;
            }
            $resolved = $parentDir . '/' . basename($candidate);
        }
        
        // Verify resolved path is within tenant boundary
        $baseResolved = realpath($ctx->getBaseDir());
        if ($baseResolved === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        if (strpos($resolved, $baseResolved . '/') !== 0 && $resolved !== $baseResolved) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $resolved;
    }
}

class FileProcessor {
    private TenantContext $ctx;
    private array $operationLog = [];

    public function __construct(TenantContext $ctx) {
        $this->ctx = $ctx;
    }

    /**
     * Process a batch of file operations from a manifest.
     * Manifest format: JSON array of {"op": "...", "path": "...", ...}
     */
    public function processBatch(string $manifestJson): array {
        $manifest = json_decode($manifestJson, true);
        if (!is_array($manifest)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid manifest format'];
        }

        $results = [];
        foreach ($manifest as $index => $operation) {
            $results[$index] = $this->executeOperation($operation);
        }
        return $results;
    }

    private function executeOperation(array $op): array {
        $type = $op['op'] ?? '';
        
        switch ($type) {
            case 'read':
                return $this->opRead($op);
            case 'write':
                return $this->opWrite($op);
            case 'copy':
                return $this->opCopy($op);
            case 'set_permissions':
                return $this->opSetPermissions($op);
            default:
                return ['error' => 'Unknown operation: ' . htmlspecialchars($type)];
        }
    }

    private function opRead(array $op): array {
        $path = PathResolver::resolve($this->ctx, $op['path'] ?? '');
        if ($path === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Path resolution failed'];
        }
        if (!is_file($path)) {
            return ['error' => 'File not found'];
        }
        $content = file_get_contents($path);
        $this->operationLog[] = ['read', $path, strlen($content)];
        return ['success' => true, 'size' => strlen($content), 'content' => base64_encode($content)];
    }

    private function opWrite(array $op): array {
        $path = PathResolver::resolve($this->ctx, $op['path'] ?? '');
        if ($path === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Path resolution failed'];
        }
        $content = base64_decode($op['content'] ?? '');
        file_put_contents($path, $content);
        $this->operationLog[] = ['write', $path, strlen($content)];
        return ['success' => true, 'bytes_written' => strlen($content)];
    }

    private function opCopy(array $op): array {
        $srcPath = PathResolver::resolve($this->ctx, $op['src'] ?? '');
        $dstPath = PathResolver::resolve($this->ctx, $op['dst'] ?? '');
        
        if ($srcPath === null || $dstPath === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Path resolution failed'];
        }
        if (!is_file($srcPath)) {
            return ['error' => 'Source file not found'];
        }
        copy($srcPath, $dstPath);
        $this->operationLog[] = ['copy', $srcPath, $dstPath];
        return ['success' => true];
    }

    /**
     * Elevate permissions for cross-tenant admin operations.
     * Only level >= 2 (admin) can modify permission metadata.
     * Admin can only modify their own tenant's permissions.
     */
    private function opSetPermissions(array $op): array {
        if ($this->ctx->getPermissionLevel() < 2) {
            return ['error' => 'Insufficient permissions'];
        }
        
        // Admin can only set permissions for their own tenant
        $targetTenant = $this->ctx->getTenantId();
        $permFile = '/var/tenants/' . $targetTenant . '/permissions.json';
        
        $perms = $op['permissions'] ?? [];
        // Prevent privilege escalation: cannot set level higher than current
        if (isset($perms['level']) && (int)$perms['level'] > $this->ctx->getPermissionLevel()) {
            return ['error' => 'Cannot escalate beyond current level'];
        }
        file_put_contents($permFile, json_encode($perms, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
        
        return ['success' => true, 'tenant' => $targetTenant];
    }
}

/**
 * Service endpoint: processes incoming request
 */
class FileService {
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        // Authenticate and build tenant context
        $tenantId = $this->authenticateTenant($request);
        if ($tenantId === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Authentication failed'];
        }

        $permLevel = $this->loadPermissionLevel($tenantId);
        $ctx = new TenantContext($tenantId, $permLevel);
        
        // Ensure tenant data directory exists
        $baseDir = $ctx->getBaseDir();
        if (!is_dir($baseDir)) {
            mkdir($baseDir, 0750, true);
        }

        $processor = new FileProcessor($ctx);
        return $processor->processBatch($request['manifest'] ?? '[]');
    }

    private function authenticateTenant(array $request): ?string {
        $token = $request['auth_token'] ?? '';
        // Token format: tenant_id.hmac_signature
        $parts = explode('.', $token, 2);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) return null;
        
        $tenantId = $parts[0];
        $signature = $parts[1];
        $secret = $this->getTenantSecret($tenantId);
        if ($secret === null) return null;
        
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $tenantId, $secret);
        if (!hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {
            return null;
        }
        return $tenantId;
    }

    private function getTenantSecret(string $tenantId): ?string {
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId);
        $secretFile = '/var/tenants/' . $sanitized . '/secret.key';
        if (!file_exists($secretFile)) return null;
        return trim(file_get_contents($secretFile));
    }

    private function loadPermissionLevel(string $tenantId): int {
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId);
        $permFile = '/var/tenants/' . $sanitized . '/permissions.json';
        if (!file_exists($permFile)) return 0;
        
        $perms = json_decode(file_get_contents($permFile), true);
        return (int)($perms['level'] ?? 0);
    }
}
